steps.query:
ref rP
ref rObj
float fA
float fB
float fC
float fD
string_var sText
array_var aList
Begin Function { }
let rP := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "14"
let rObj := GetFormFromMod "FalloutNV.esm" "104C0F"
let fA := rObj.GetAngle Z
rObj.SetAngleEx 0 0 (fA + 90)
let fB := rObj.GetAngle Z
rObj.SetAngleEx 0 0 fA
let fC := rObj.GetAngle Z
SetFunctionValue (sv_Construct "%.1f %.1f" (fB - fA) (fC - fA))
End
steps.label: jip13.setangleex.doc
